items.event: Presidents Cup — USA completes historic comeback
items.line: USA trailed the Internationals 10.5–7.5 entering Sunday singles at Medinah — the biggest deficit ever overcome on foreign soil — and stormed back to win the Cup for the 10th straight time. Keegan Bradley delivered the clinching point after Si Woo Kim missed a 10-foot putt on 18.

items.event: Laver Cup — Team Europe reclaims the trophy
items.line: Team Europe beat Team World 13-5 at The O2 in London. Alexander Zverev sealed it with a 7-6(3), 6-3 win over Learner Tien — his fourth career clinching match and the first Laver Cup title for captain Yannick Noah.

items.event: Japan Open (Tokyo) — Alcaraz defends on home-ish soil
items.line: Carlos Alcaraz defends his Japan Open title at Ariake Coliseum, Tokyo, with Ben Shelton also in the ATP 500 field. Main draw runs Sep 30-Oct 4 — worth flagging even though it's already in JST, no jet lag required for this one.
